mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.section_id, s.user_id, u.username as user_name, s.github_url, s.content, s.checklist_result, s.score, s.rating, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM challenge_submissions s LEFT JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id WHERE s.section_id = #{sectionId} ORDER BY s.created_at ASC

SELECT s.id, s.section_id, s.user_id, u.username as user_name, s.github_url, s.content, s.checklist_result, s.score, s.rating, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM challenge_submissions s LEFT JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id WHERE s.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO challenge_submissions (section_id, user_id, github_url, content, checklist_result, score) VALUES (#{sectionId}, #{userId}, #{githubUrl}, #{content}, #{checklistResult}, #{score})
mapper.update: UPDATE challenge_submissions SET rating=#{rating}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}
